bible.text: Come to me, all you who are weary and burdened, and I will give you rest.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... I'm so tired. I keep trying and trying and nothing works.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You don't have to carry all of it by yourself anymore.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: But if I stop trying, won't everything just fall apart?

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Rest isn't quitting. Rest is where I meet you and carry what you can't.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: What's making you tired right now?
